title: pi-gate configuration
description: Rules used by @zeldrisho/pi-gate to allow, block, or confirm bash commands.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

promptTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for an interactive confirmation, in milliseconds.

operations.description: Case-insensitive command patterns. Simple commands use word matching and ignore literal echo/printf arguments; complex syntax uses substring matching. Contained allow matches suppress restrictions; remaining blocks win.
